list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. No online trophies.
platinumEstimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough (PowerPyx). No mission replay; cheats disable trophies and saving.

powerpyx.usedFor: Roadmap, counts, locations and per-trophy method, played from the released game.

exophase.usedFor: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades.

outputlag.usedFor: Cross-check of the 55 names, grades and the one missable trophy.

gtazone.usedFor: Cross-check of names, counts and the platinum estimate.

gtavibes.usedFor: Cross-check that all 55 are single-player with no online trophies.

comingsoon.usedFor: The 100% checklist thresholds (scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges).

leonida.usedFor: Cross-check of the list make-up and the missable warning.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours — there is no extra task behind it. Treat this guide as the checklist: finish the story, work the 100% list, then sweep the one-offs. Expect about 200 hours at a relaxed pace; PowerPyx rates the set 4/10, so it is long, not hard.
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1-5).
Complete the 100% Completion checklist.
Clean up the remaining trophies in Stage 3.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when the opening mission Gone Fishing ends — just play Chapter 1 from the start and it unlocks on its own.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Keep playing the main missions and it pops as the story moves into Chapter 2, which opens with What's in the Bag?
steps: Play every Chapter 1 main mission to the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Unmissable — it pops after the last Chapter 2 mission, as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.
steps: Play every Chapter 2 main mission to the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It pops once the chapter's last missions are done and the story moves into Chapter 4, which opens with Ocean Beach.
steps: Play every Chapter 3 main mission to the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Keep playing the main missions; it pops after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.
steps: Play every Chapter 4 main mission to the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the final mission — the gold for beating the game. Keep a manual save from before it: there is no mission replay, so a save is the only way back to the ending.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Finish the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission itself — just play the story and it comes to you.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It pops during the mission — no side task needed.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the mission — just keep playing the story.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It pops during the mission — unmissable, like every story trophy.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It pops during the mission — the airport raid is part of the main story, so you cannot skip past it.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops during the mission, near the end of the story.
steps: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy, and the whole platinum in miniature. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but everything you do during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds, about 60% true completion: scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish any 70 of 80 challenges, do any 100 optional missions, and complete the required robberies, ranges, drone races, underwater finds and Bret's quests, plus 15 of 18 meditations. Nothing on the list is missable.
steps: Open the checklist after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion).
Scan new vehicles early with WAiNK and study animals with the binoculars.
Do optional missions as they appear — you need any 100.
Finish the required robberies, ranges, drone races and 70 of 80 challenges.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. Mix the four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — and pick the easiest for you; flying under bridges in a plane is the quickest. Track them on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots: each has a unique name and stays marked once done. The 100% list wants 300, so keep going after this pops.
steps: Open the map > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see found stunts.
Clear under-the-bridge flights first — they are the fastest.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types you have done. Most come naturally through the story and map exploration; filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icons) to find the rest.
steps: Check Progress > Activities to see the 9 types and your progress.
Filter the map for Activities to find the types you still need.
Do one of each — a single try is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The gold times and scores are lenient: use a steady weapon, take the timed lanes at a calm pace, and redo any silver until it turns gold. Ranges are marked on the map, and your progress is tracked in the trophy list.
steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges.
Gold every challenge — redo silvers until they turn gold.
Check the trophy tracker for the challenges still missing gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race. Drone races are marked on the map — fly the course slowly once to learn it, then race it clean.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race on the map.
Win one race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, and car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count. A win only counts the first time at each location, so keep moving to new spots instead of repeating one.
steps: Win a race at a new location — each location counts once.
Repeat at 20 different locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you have met Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple map icon. Follow his short questline and out-fish him. The spot stays available, so this is not missable.
steps: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Follow Cal's text to the marked fishing spot.
Beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are 4 video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of any one game once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.
steps: Pick any of the 4 video games.
Finish all of its levels once.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline (Lucia only). In Chapter 3, playing as Lucia, Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville, which marks the questline on the map. Complete her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
steps: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, wait for Andy's call and text.
Follow the Belville marker and complete her 5 quests.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams; Kenton calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. Dive for his treasures — 7 shipwrecks in total, marked with purple chest icons — using the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring each set back to his shop. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3; playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
steps: Meet Kenton after Island Dreams in Chapter 1.
Dive the marked shipwrecks and bring each treasure set back.
Keep answering his calls until all 7 wrecks are cleared.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Complete Billy's 5 jobs.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — confirmed ones include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's McKittrick Farm jobs, Yago's street-racing arc and Pilot Pete's delivery runs. The named side characters (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do NOT count toward this one. Everything is still available in free-roam after the story; the trophy tracker shows how many strands you have.
steps: Find stranger questlines in the open world (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete).
Complete 8 strands — check the trophy tracker for your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. It opens in Chapter 3 during the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, when you steal the Zorrusso with the Key Cloner. Randy then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to deliver to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Scan cars with WAiNK to check them against the list, steal them anywhere, and deliver them in good condition for more money. Cars are plentiful around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and he marks new ones as you deliver.
steps: Steal the Zorrusso for Randy in Chapter 3.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to check the wish list.
Deliver all 16 cars to his garage.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline (Jason only). It opens in Chapter 3 after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple around Vice City (quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives you the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down for good. Still available after the story.
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, find the marked Synthetic Labs.
Destroy the labs, then complete Tyrone's Spin On This quest.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. You can meditate as Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. THE ONE TO WATCH: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you can follow and choose Accept. That meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not yet confirmed whether it counts toward the trophy, so do it to be safe. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. You cannot do the last meditation until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2: Coffee Break). For 100% you only need 15 of 18.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — do Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter ends.
Visit all 18 meditation spots across Leonida.
Meditate as both Jason and Lucia at each spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret (Jason only). After Chapter 2: Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason and marks the quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His questline is about hunting the animals he requests and bringing them to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track his requests under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 decks, all needed for 100%, so this comes naturally along the way.
steps: After Coffee Break, answer Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets hidden around Leonida — you need any 3 finished. Cards are scattered through the world, so sweep them in one planned route using the card-location guide in the sources rather than hunting at random.
steps: Pick 3 card sets to complete.
Follow the card locations and collect every card of those sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up + R1 with the WAiNK app to scan landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. Any 100 count and there are more than 100, so scan whatever you pass — it stacks with the vehicle scanning you need for the 100% list.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan what you pass.
Scan any 100 landmarks, curiosities, sculptures or tags.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You need 70 for 100%, so this pops on the way there. Check Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest remaining ones — many complete naturally while you work on other trophies, so leave this for late cleanup and then mop up the quickest ones left.
steps: Check Progress > Challenges for what you have done.
Pick the easiest remaining challenges until you reach 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Available once you can free-roam as both characters (after Chapter 2: Coffee Break) — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Cause chaos until you reach 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone on a fast bike; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because the helicopter cannot follow you there. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always trigger 4 stars.
steps: Call your partner (Right + Triangle) after Chapter 2: Coffee Break.
Reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone — try the train tunnel north of Ambrosia.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the flashing wanted level alive (not the red heat level) while you hit 3 robbery targets in a row — bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well (available after Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a couple of items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and the trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop. If it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
steps: Call your partner and stock up on armor, sticky bombs and healing.
Rob 3 shops in a row while keeping the wanted level alive.
If it does not pop after the third, hit a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles as they pass — you do not need to drive them. A busy road in Vice City fills the list fast. There are 557 vehicles at launch; for 100% you need 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning after this pops. Check Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles for totals by category.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on a busy road.
Scan 100 different vehicles — driving them is not needed.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but the focus bar drains fast. Buff focus first (eat, drink, wash up at home, or use Adrenaline from the weapon wheel), wear body armor, and line up 5 enemies at a gang operation with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.
steps: Buff your focus bar (food, drink, Adrenaline).
Find 5 enemies grouped at a gang operation.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3) and drop all 5 in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — one connected to a boarding bridge; the planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops.
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the plane at terminals E3/E4.
Board through the stairs by the boarding bridge.
Take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Find the Rhinos at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive in through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot until the trophy pops.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Enter the base and climb into a Rhino tank.
Shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the safe code on a note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. The trophy pops shortly after you leave.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun.
Loot the safe, destroy the footage, disable the alarm, leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. It starts with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner along to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans (finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first). Each vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to break the search. There are 8 large bank jobs; 5 pop this trophy, all 8 are needed for 100%.
steps: Do the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
Buy Yasmani's security-van tips ($10,000 each).
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults counts automatically — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as the truck robbery. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
steps: Do the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (counts automatically).
Or: stop an armored truck, bomb its back door, escape the heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map, all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible. It counts toward 100% and pairs naturally with scanning vehicles from the air.
steps: Get a plane.
Fly over every fogged area until the whole map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you get near them (many are also marked by story progress). One per gang pops this trophy; all 39 are needed for 100%. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.
steps: Find an illegal operation (yellow map icon).
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. You need the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City — steal it only after you have the Key Cloner from Chapter 3: Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack in, drive forward straight through the showroom window; the trophy pops a moment later, once you are out on the street. Only that blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3.
Go to the south Vice City showroom and hack the blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). It unlocks during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery icon respawns and you can return for what you missed.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
During Hit Kingpin Bowling, take the watch, the shotgun and the safe.
Escape the police — the trophy pops after.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Chapter 2: Coffee Break, when you can switch between both. Work out together (call your partner with Right + Triangle): while one trains, the other progresses too, so you gain double. Buy a fitness club membership and use clubs across Vice City (filter the map for Activities), or work out at home after the story. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership.
Work out with both characters together until both hit max strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives, clean getaways and destroying evidence build the Professional side; limb shots build Hardened; killing builds Violent; mass cop and civilian kills build Psycho; keep going and the profile can become permanently Irredeemable — avoid that, since police shoot on sight. It accrues passively through robberies and fights, so leave it for late cleanup and, if needed, farm the last few with a car in a busy area.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI.
Play normally — robberies and fights all count.
Farm the remainder late if needed; avoid going Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest note: this one is not pinned down yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 20 November 2026, so do not grind for it on a guess — it will most likely pop while you work the Payday Loans robberies in Chapter 3. Check the sources linked here for updates once players confirm it.
steps: Do the Payday Loans robberies in Chapter 3.
Check the linked guides for a confirmed trigger before grinding.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you will see the UFO's bright blue light in the sky. Approach it, it drops the woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, so repeat visits may be needed.
steps: Go alone, after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel.
Look for the blinking car; if absent, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the woman.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: on a motorcycle or push bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
steps: Get on a motorcycle or push bike in a crowded area.
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3: Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this finishes naturally while doing the 100% robberies.
steps: Finish Chapter 3: Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, deliver marked bills to a fence.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — the most expensive items. Any shop counts: Ammu-Nations, mod shops, Pay 'n' Sprays, clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, tattoo studios and electronics stores.
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (4 more come from the story and do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale after Chapter 2: Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy them through the app. Robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest money.
steps: Finish Chapter 2: Daily Driver to unlock the Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garages through the phone app ($160,000 total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after Chapter 2: Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). Buy enough garages first — each adds parking spots — then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. He only takes vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
steps: Unlock the Scooter Bros app in Chapter 2: Moses.
Buy garages for parking spots.
Drive 10 stolen vehicles to Moses and register them.
